name: FishingRodMsg
meaning: Messages handled by FishingRod_HandleMessage 0x4bdf55 (jump table 0x4be492 / 0x4be4c6); also the default of CompositeRod_HandleMessage

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach to sender joint arg, shadow hidden, anim 6

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach, SetPosition(arg), state 0, anim 7 (does not end fishing)

name: MSG_CARRY_ANIM
meaning: while fishing: arg 0xC -> anim 2, 0xD -> 3, 0xE -> 4, other -> 1 (Wolf states 0xAE/0xAF/0xB0 carry those nibbles)

name: MSG_HELD_STATE_END
meaning: fishing: EndFishing, state 3, anim 5; else state 0, anim 6

name: MSG_ROD_TIP_BLOCKED
meaning: FishingRod_IsTipBlocked(arg pos, sender rot); nonzero refuses the Wolf's sidestep
